parsed.explanation: No trans-specific criminalisation, no documented border friction, no facility ban, no police targeting, and no recorded trans-specific violence. Institutional climate is genuinely positive: gender-identity employment protection since 2005, legal gender change since 2007, and a unanimous 2022 comprehensive SOGI anti-discrimination act (effective 2023) that rejected religious and small-business exemptions, plus a consensual reform record on adoption and marriage. But this is a thin dossier with no visitor-facing evidence: no documented service-refusal remedy actually operating, no prosecution of anti-trans attackers recorded, no social-attitude data, and prison placement and border screening unresolved (open questions, light weight). Residual male homosexual offences are a dead-letter tangential signal with no documented use against gender-nonconforming people. Strong structural signals, but a step below the acceptance-with-working-protections tier.
